meta.title: Questions to answer before deciding
meta.intro: Items needed before a reasonable decision can be made. Split into what only you can answer, and what still needs research (with a suggested way to find it).

fromYou.question: Which nights do you want: 3 nights (Mon Feb 15 to Thu Feb 18, 2027, your preferred window) or 7 nights (Feb 15 to Feb 22)?
fromYou.why: The brief asks for 7-night totals, but the preferred window is 3 nights. Totals and per-night prices change completely.

fromYou.question: What is your total budget for the hotel (and per night), and is there a maximum for dinners per couple?
fromYou.why: No budget was given. Without a cap, hotels cannot be ranked by price.

fromYou.question: Is a private bathroom and a queen (or larger) bed a hard requirement, or a preference?
fromYou.why: The brief treats it as required. Only one hotel's bed type was confirmed from an official page (Caesars Palace, 2 queens).

fromYou.question: Which activities do you actually want? (Hoover Dam, Red Rock, Valley of Fire, Neon Museum, Grand Canyon, Mount Charleston, others?)
fromYou.why: Only four activities have official pages read so far. The 1-hour travel filter depends on this list.

fromYou.question: How do you plan to travel: rideshare, RTC bus, Monorail, or a rental car?
fromYou.why: The brief asks for subway or bus within 1 hour. Las Vegas has no subway on official transit sites, and bus times are not yet verified for each hotel.

fromYou.question: Do you accept the Feb 15 (Presidents' Day, a federal holiday) start, or would you move the trip to another date in the Feb 15 to Mar 23 window?
fromYou.why: The preferred start falls on a federal holiday. Effect on prices is unverified.

fromYou.question: Which Michelin tier matters most: starred restaurants (4 in Las Vegas), Bib Gourmand (3), or any Recommended (17)?
fromYou.why: Hotels are ranked by the count of nearby Michelin listings, so the tier choice changes the ranking.

fromYou.question: Is there an occasion (anniversary, birthday) that changes dinner priority or room upgrades?
fromYou.why: Affects which starred restaurant and which room type to prioritize.

fromYou.question: What cancellation terms are acceptable (free cancellation vs. prepaid lower rate)?
fromYou.why: Booking timing advice depends on whether you can cancel and rebook if prices drop.

fromYou.question: Do you want the site to track prices automatically (manual check each week) or a one-time snapshot?
fromYou.why: Determines whether a price-tracking method is in scope (see Suggestions).

research.question: What are the 7-night totals for the hotels above for Feb 15 to 22, 2027?
research.missing: No official rate for these dates could be read. Rates are dynamic and not published in advance.
research.howToDiscover: Check each hotel's official booking calendar for the dates (read and record the total with taxes and fees). Record the date and time of each check.

research.question: Which hotel rooms have a private bathroom and a queen or larger bed?
research.missing: Only Caesars Palace (2 queens) confirmed. Venetian room page and Bellagio room page did not load.
research.howToDiscover: Open each hotel's official room list and record bed type and bathroom wording for the rooms shown.

research.question: Which Michelin restaurants have current hours and price for two?
research.missing: Hours confirmed for 4 starred restaurants (Guy Savoy hours not confirmed). No couple price confirmed for any restaurant (official menu prices not read).
research.howToDiscover: Read each restaurant's official menu/price page and hours page; record date checked.

research.question: What is the drive or transit time from each candidate hotel to each activity?
research.missing: No travel time verified. RTC trip planner was not queried.
research.howToDiscover: Use the RTC trip planner (official) and record minutes for each pair; for driving, record the time from a mapping source and label it as unofficial.

research.question: What are the official social media accounts (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram) for each restaurant and activity?
research.missing: Only Neon Museum (TikTok and Instagram) and Hoover Dam (Facebook link) confirmed on official pages.
research.howToDiscover: Open each official site and read the footer or social icons. Record the URL and date checked. Do not use search-result handles without checking the official site.

research.question: Does the Las Vegas MICHELIN list on guide.michelin.com match the press release?
research.missing: The guide.michelin.com page did not load through the fetch tool.
research.howToDiscover: Open guide.michelin.com and filter Las Vegas; compare to the 24 entries here.

research.question: Are there Feb 2027 events (conventions, sports, shows) that raise prices?
research.missing: No event calendar for Feb 15 to 22, 2027 was read.
research.howToDiscover: Check the official Las Vegas tourism calendar (visitlasvegas.com) and the venue calendars.

research.question: When is the cheapest time to book a hotel for these dates?
research.missing: No official historical or forward rate data read. Only current promotions are verified (see Booking timing).
research.howToDiscover: Record the lowest total on each official booking calendar over several weeks (dated snapshots), then compare. This needs time and is not a one-time check.
